status: predeclared before retrieval or transport experiments
fixture: fixture.json (SHA256 pinned in freeze.json before run)
dataset: invented public bilingual facts; no private corpus; no real-work effectiveness inference

split.tuning_policy: no parameter tuning; report held-out only

language_labels: query intent language; some Russian-intent scope/lifecycle probes use literal English anchors; report this limitation

lexical.pg_rank: ts_rank, not BM25; no inherited relative floor

vectors.fallback: if genuine model unavailable, no vector quality claims; mechanics only

controls: full baseline twice must have identical ranked IDs/versions
same remaining source rows/history before and after each arm
auxiliary and metadata tokens absent from content-only lexical index
identical eligibility filters before limit across all PG channels

thresholds.production_go: requires private held-out corpus, actual agent loop and authorized remote path; synthetic results cannot pass

scope: local research only; no ANN/scale extrapolation, no model-driven retries or final-answer claims
